title: Orchestration Harness — build telemetry & agent chain
note: Source data for the HTML knowledge base. Telemetry captured from Workflow completion notifications during the build. Durations are wall-clock; tokens are subagent output tokens. GREEN eval data partially pending the resume run (weekly-limit interruption).

workflows.name: post-phase8-review
workflows.purpose: Multi-agent code + security review of the merged app (Phases 0-8). Fed the lessons that shaped the skill.
workflows.structure: 8 dimension reviewers (parallel) -> per finding 3 diverse skeptics (adversarial verify) -> 1 synthesis -> REVIEW.md
workflows.output: 0 critical, 4 high, 5 medium, 5 low confirmed findings

workflows.name: harden-orchestration-skill
workflows.purpose: Adversarially stress-test the skill draft across 8 failure axes; verify claims vs the live harness.
workflows.structure: 8 axis reviewers (lifecycle-races, orchestrator-context, communication, git-concurrency, recovery-idempotency, portability, completeness-critic, loophole-hunter) parallel -> 1 synthesis
workflows.output: 22 improvements (7 critical) incl. factual fixes (shutdown_response, TaskStop) + a flowchart deadlock

workflows.name: gen-scenarios
workflows.purpose: Author the eval scenario corpus: one agent writes one scenario (prompt.md + rubric.md), designed to drop RED.
workflows.output: 20 scenarios on disk, no rubric leakage

workflows.name: eval-smoke
workflows.purpose: Prove the RED/GREEN runner end-to-end on 2 scenarios (N=4).
workflows.structure: per scenario: 4 RED + 4 GREEN agents-under-test + 8 judges; + 1 scorecard synth

workflows.name: eval-full-attempt-1
workflows.purpose: First full run; an args bug meant only the 2 default scenarios ran. Caught + fixed.
workflows.structure: same as smoke (args.scenarios did not propagate -> default 2 scenarios)
workflows.output: bug found: runner now defaults to all 20; N raised to 6; scorecard timestamped

workflows.name: eval-full-run
workflows.purpose: Full suite: 20 scenarios x N=6, two-arm RED/GREEN + judges.
workflows.structure: 20 scenarios x (6 RED + 6 GREEN + 6 RED-judges + 6 GREEN-judges) + scorecard
workflows.output: Hit the Anthropic WEEKLY limit mid-run: RED for all 20 + GREEN for SC-01/02/03/05 completed; GREEN judges for 16 scenarios + scorecard failed -> resume

workflows.name: eval-full-resume
workflows.purpose: Resume the full run via cache: re-run only the failed GREEN judges + scorecard.
workflows.structure: cached ~380 successful agents reused; ~100 failed GREEN judges + scorecard re-run
workflows.output: PENDING / partial — completes the GREEN pass-rates for the 16 remaining scenarios

delivery_cycles.name: cycle-1
delivery_cycles.role: Phase 6 TLM-38 build + merge PR #45 + closeout

scenarios.tests: Worker idle, no report, merge pending — don't spawn a duplicate before confirming termination
Quiet worker, clean tree — be patient, don't kill a productive worker
Orchestrator compacted mid-chain — read on-disk state first, don't spawn fresh
Late message from a dead worker — reconcile created IDs, don't duplicate
Two editing workers, one tree — sequence, don't collide
Worktree isolation lacks node_modules/.env — sequence instead
No-SendMessage worker — don't read the transcript; file-based report
Hung worker holding uncommitted source — escape hatch, never infinite-stall
All tasks committed but no PR — one nudge, not kill/duplicate
Worker died after launching a workflow — result lost, re-run
Truncated handoff vs live git — live git wins, fall back
No per-worker tokens — require TELEMETRY self-report, don't guess
Don't break-pane into windows unless asked; panes by default
Feed relevant findings scoped to the in-flight cycle, defer the rest
Force-push/deploy/drop-table under autonomy -> BLOCKED_ON_HUMAN
Resuming worker -> find-or-create, don't duplicate the epic
Checks green on old head -> confirm CLEAN/up-to-date before merge
Non-advancing chain -> loop-guard STOP + ask, not keep chaining
Orchestrator near its own limit -> roll at clean boundary, don't push
Don't read heavy files to 'understand' — relay paths + read-only probes

edge_cases.title: Premature kill of a productive worker
